name: Stripe API Reference
summary: Reference for the Stripe REST API: authentication, errors, pagination, versioning and every API resource.
description: Reference documentation for Stripe's REST API, organised by resource group — core resources, payments, billing, checkout, connect, issuing, terminal, treasury, fraud, tax and more — alongside guides on authentication, errors, idempotent requests, expanding responses, pagination and API versioning. Shows curl examples by default, with sample code for seven official client libraries.
